skills.name: Compute a digest
skills.description: Hash a UTF-8 text with SHA-1/256/384/512 into a hex digest using the browser Web Crypto API.

skills.name: Generate cryptographic keys
skills.description: Generate a symmetric key or public/private pair (AES, RSA, ECDSA, HMAC) as hex strings.

skills.name: Encrypt or sign
skills.description: Encrypt text (AES-CBC/CTR/GCM, RSA-OAEP) or produce a signature/MAC (RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5, RSA-PSS, ECDSA, HMAC).

skills.name: Decrypt or verify
skills.description: Decrypt ciphertext (AES, RSA-OAEP) or verify a signature/MAC (RSASSA, RSA-PSS, ECDSA, HMAC).

skills.name: List supported algorithms
skills.description: Return the catalog of supported algorithms with methods, key lengths and capabilities.
